sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: Signature Audit checks whether people's Gmail signatures match the current system data (title, phone, institution details and the selected template). Instead of hunting for stale signatures one by one, you can find and fix them in bulk.

bullets.desc: Pick the scope, target template and check depth.
For each person the expected signature is computed and compared to the current state.
Results are grouped into categories; expand a row to see what changed.
Select the people to update and start a bulk update.

sections.heading: Scope and Depth
paragraphs: You choose who the check covers and how deep it looks.

callout.text: Running it for the first time? Pick Deep — Fast mode has no records yet, so it would mark everyone as "Needs update".

sections.heading: Result Categories
paragraphs: After the scan, each person falls into a category:

rows: The signature is as it should be — no action needed.
Data or template has changed; the signature is stale.
The person's Gmail signature is empty (reliably detected only in Deep mode).
Title, phone or institution match is missing — skipped, no signature is pushed.
Profile or signature information could not be fetched.

sections.heading: Drift Detection and Update
paragraphs: On every successful signature push the system stores a fingerprint of the signature. The scan compares the target signature computed from current data against this record — if they differ, the person is marked "Needs update".
On the review screen you can use "Select updatable" to check all drifted people and click Update Selected. The update always overwrites — the system is the single source of truth.

callout.text: The update overwrites each person's existing signature. Manual customizations are replaced too.

bullets.desc: Suspended users are excluded from the audit.
People missing a title, phone or institution match are marked "Missing data" and are not updated — no half-filled signature is pushed.
This feature does not run on a schedule; you always start the audit yourself.
The update also appears in Job History; if there are errors you can download a report.
